# The life cycle of fix/life142: changing dimension, dying, the title screen, leaving and joining the world again.
# This branch changes nothing that shows in pictures (its fix is a log line at quitting), so the branch run and the
# main run should match; the pictures are a look at how the code behaves around these events (1280x720, GUI scale 2
# as the test world starts, a clear night, World layout, aurora). What to look for:
#  1. life-overworld, then life-nether-arrive / life-nether: in the Nether none of the Overworld's World words hang
#     anywhere (they start afresh round you), the song title does NOT float up again, no aurora. life-back-arrive /
#     life-back: in the Overworld again no Nether words left over, and the aurora fades back in. The log should say
#     "world line starts over (other: newLyrics ... a world change)" once per change.
#  2. life-dead: on the death screen the words drop away; life-respawned: they start afresh round you.
#  3. life-title: the title screen with the lyrics under its buttons.
#  4. life-join-0 ... life-join-8 (seconds after the server logs the join): once the loading screen is gone the song's
#     title should float up in front of you (facing south, a little up) and stay its few seconds (about 4 s). Suspected
#     from the code, not seen yet: the world is drawn behind the loading screen, and the title is put up there, so it
#     shows only for what is left of its 4 s, or not at all if loading takes longer. No words or sky from before leaving.
#  5. life-arc-synth: Arc and the synthwave sky, both picked on the title screen, show in the next world, the sky
#     fully faded in (not left half done) and the Arc line in front of you.
# Run it on the branch, and with -f mod_ref=main to compare with the old code:
#   gh workflow run screenshots.yml --ref fix/life142 -f version=1.21.11 -f script=.github/checks/life142.txt
#   gh workflow run screenshots.yml --ref fix/life142 -f version=1.21.11 -f mod_ref=main -f script=.github/checks/life142.txt

# A clear night that stays night; World words and the aurora (the defaults)
cmd weather clear
cmd time set midnight
cmd gamerule doDaylightCycle false
cmd gamerule advance_time false
cmd effect give @p minecraft:resistance 900 255 true
set layout WORLD
set sky AURORA
look 0 -15
sleep 10
where
shot life-overworld

# 1. Into the Nether, then a cleared pocket on an obsidian floor round you
cmd execute in minecraft:the_nether run tp @p 0 100 0
sleep 2
shot life-nether-arrive
sleep 4
cmd execute as @p at @p run fill ~-3 ~ ~-3 ~3 ~3 ~3 minecraft:air
cmd execute as @p at @p run fill ~-3 ~-1 ~-3 ~3 ~-1 ~3 minecraft:obsidian
look 0 -15
sleep 6
where
shot life-nether

# Back to the Overworld at the world spawn (where the server console runs its commands from)
cmd execute in minecraft:overworld run tp @p ~ ~ ~
sleep 2
look 0 -15
shot life-back-arrive
sleep 8
where
shot life-back

# 2. Dying and respawning
cmd kill @p
sleep 1.5
shot life-dead
press Respawn
sleep 3
look 0 -15
sleep 5
shot life-respawned

# 3. The title screen
cmd effect give @p minecraft:resistance 900 255 true
look 0 -15
sleep 1
quit
sleep 6
shot life-title

# 4. Joining again: pictures from the moment the server logs the join
join SkyTest
wait joined the game
shot life-join-0
sleep 1
shot life-join-1
sleep 1
shot life-join-2
sleep 1
shot life-join-3
sleep 2
shot life-join-5
sleep 3
shot life-join-8
where

# 5. Settings changed on the title screen, then joining again
look 0 -15
sleep 1
quit
sleep 5
set layout ARC
set sky SYNTHWAVE
sleep 1
join SkyTest
wait joined the game
sleep 8
look 0 -15
sleep 4
shot life-arc-synth
set layout WORLD
set sky AURORA
